messages:
maria (CS): Heads-up: Lexa Labs onboarding saw a rapid scale (2 -> 50) in staging and hit intermittent 429s + a few 401s during SDK init (node sdk v0.8.3). Happens in first 30s. Need quick triage.

jordan (SE): Can you paste sample logs / headers? 429 header values?

maria (CS): Redacted snippet:
[14:02:12Z] init preflight start pod-17
[14:02:12Z] http 401 POST /v1/sdk/init -> {error: "invalid_token"}
[14:02:13Z] http 429 POST /v1/preflight -> {error: "rate_limited"} headers: x-rate-limit-reset=22

sam (SDK): Known issue in v0.8.3: parallel worker startups cause token refresh + preflight fanout. Recommend upgrade to v0.8.5 (adds startup splay and refresh coalescing). Workaround: set REDWOOD_SDK_PREFLIGHT_STAGGER_MS="200-600" and REDWOOD_PREFLIGHT_CONCURRENCY=2. Keep keepAlive true.

tina_ops: Also ask them to check host clock (NT P). JWT skew causes 401 then retry storms. Enabling persistent connections reduces per-connection accounting.

ravi (eng-infra): I'll temporarily raise token bucket for their tenant and add tracing. Creating incident for tracking.

deploy-bot: Incident created CS-6421 (Lexa onboarding preflight storm).

maria (CS): Update: Lexa applied upgrade + env vars + fixed NTP. After controlled ramp errors fell from ~6% to ~0.2%. Leaving incident open for monitoring. Runbook note: add "stagger preflight on scale-up" and host-time check to onboarding checklist.
